content: The documentation https://gluon-cv.mxnet.io/ and http://gluon-nlp.mxnet.io/ of GluonCV/NLP include installation instructions, contribution instructions, open source repositories, extensive API reference, and comprehensive tutorials. As another benefit of leveraging the MXNet ecosystem, the GluonCV/NLP documentation is supplemented by the interactive open source book Dive into Deep Learning (based on the Gluon API of MXNet) BIBREF7 , which provides sufficient background knowledge about GluonCV/NLP tasks, models, and building blocks. Notably, some users of Dive into Deep Learning have later become contributors of GluonCV/NLP.
